fixture: n independent local developmental units, each with three distinguishable local states: teachable-unlearned, stubborn-unlearned, learned; legal events query_i and teach1_i
interpretation: Every Cartesian combination of local developmental status is future-trace distinguishable, so exact global developmental minimization cannot quotient below 3^n states.
3^n distinguishable states do not require Theta(3^n) bits to encode one current state: the fixed-length lower bound is ceil(log2(3^n)) = Theta(n).
The same machine has a compact factorized model description: n local state cells plus one shared six-entry local rule table; one teaching event updates one cell.
The exponential succinctness claim is therefore relative to flat global transition/model enumeration, not the information needed to identify one exact current state.
This does not establish fundamental cognitive atoms: ordinary factored state models, DBNs, programs and factored MDPs already exploit such compact structure.
claim_ceiling: exact resource-factorization calibration only; no exponential current-state information compression, unique cognitive unit or GMI law
